text:
marta: Quick security advisory — audit found several old RSA keys on prod bastions that fail our entropy/age checks. We need all human SSH keys rotated and bastion access migrated to the Zero Trust SSO (ZTA) flow. Deadline: 72 hours from now. This is mandatory for any account with prod access. :rotating_light:

marta: Required steps (short):
1) Generate a new ed25519 key locally: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "redwood-bastion-<your-username>"`
2) Upload pubkey via the internal portal: https://redwood.internal/bastion-keys
3) Enroll your account in ZTA: https://redwood.internal/zta/onboard (SSO + device attestation)
4) Confirm here in this thread when done.

marta: Infra will rotate any lingering machine/service keys where humans can't rotate them directly. If you have CI/service accounts that use long-lived keys, open a ticket to request a managed key swap.

dan: How automated is step 2? Can we provide a script for teams?

marta: Yes — infra has a helper CLI. Example: `rw-infra bastion upload-key --user $(whoami) --pubkey ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub`. Link to CLI and docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/bastion-rekey.

alex_oncall: If someone is on-call and can't complete full enrollment in 72h, what should they do to keep access?

marta: If you're on-call and can't finish ZTA enrolment immediately, request temporary OTP-based session from eng-oncall team via the ephemeral-access flow (`/ephemeral-access request --reason "oncall"`). That grants 1 hour and we log it. Not a substitute for rotation — still need to complete full steps within 72h.

priya: Confirming backend team will rotate keys for all devs on our services. We'll need the infra CLI installed on dev boxes. ETA: ~36h.

infra-bot: Created ticket SEC-438: "Prod bastion SSH key rotation + ZTA onboarding" and scheduled scan job to re-run in 72h. https://phabricator.redwood/SEC-438

engbot: Reminder set for 48h (channel: @eng-security).

dan: For service accounts: we'll run the Ansible playbook `rotate-bastion-service-keys.yml` from infra repo. It will swap keys and update vault entries. Please open SEC tickets with service account names and owners.

priya: One question — any change to our jump host IP allowlist? Our CI pulls over SSH from jump host.

marta: No changes to IP allowlist for this rollout. The change is purely key material + ZTA. CI that uses machine/service keys should be scheduled with infra; we will coordinate to avoid deploy interruptions.

dan: Pushing a helper snippet for teams that want to batch-rotate (example Ansible task):
```
- name: rotate bastion pubkey
  authorized_key:
    user: "{{ item.user }}"
    state: present
    key: "{{ lookup('file', item.pubkey_path) }}"
```

marta: TL;DR: everyone with prod bastion access — rotate human SSH keys to ed25519, upload via portal or use infra CLI, enroll in ZTA, confirm in this thread. Infra will handle service accounts on request. Deadline: 72h.

dan: Done on bastion-{1..3} for the infra team nodes. Uploaded via CLI.

priya: Backend team finished key rotation for our devs. Posting list in SEC ticket.

marta: Thanks — marking teams that reported as "complete". I'll run a targeted scan and update SEC-438. If you haven't started, prioritize this now.

engbot: Scan job started (SEC-438-scan-1). Results due in ~2h.

marta: Final note — anyone who cannot complete for legitimate reasons, DM me and cc your manager. We will grant time-limited exceptions but will follow up for permanent remediation. :lock:
